UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Req_Clear_Stumps: Hammer, Sledgehammer, Club Hammer, Pickaxe or Stone Maul
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Req_Clear_Boulders: Hammer, Sledgehammer, Club Hammer, Pickaxe or Stone Maul
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Gather_Logs: Automatically gather logs in the selected area and moves them to your designated storage area/container.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Gather_Planks: Searches the area for planks to gather and moves them to your designated storage area/container..
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Gather_Firewo: Collect all cut firewood from the ground and moves them to your designated storage area/container.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Gather_Stones: Pick up all stones and rocks.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Gather_Branch: Gather twigs and branches from the ground.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Clear_Trees: Chop down all trees in the selected area. Requires an axe.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Clear_Stumps: Remove tree stumps. Requires a tool with the Remove Stump tag.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Clear_Bushes: Clear out bushes and shrubs with a cutting tool.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Clear_Boulder: Breaks apart large boulders into usable stones. Requires a pickaxe or sledgehammer.
UI_WorkOrders_Menu_Tooltip_Saw_Planks: Automatically processes gathered logs into planks using a saw.
UI_WorkOrders_ModOptions_KeepMenuOnTop: Keep Work Orders Right-Click Option At Top
UI_WorkOrders_ModOptions_StopNearZombies: Stop Auto-Working When Zombies Are Near
UI_WorkOrders_KeyConflict: The key "%1" is already assigned to "%2".
UI_BOYD_Menu_Tooltip_Outdoor: Pick a drop-off square, then drag an area. Every zombie corpse in the area is hauled to your drop-off spot.
UI_BOYD_Menu_Tooltip_Indoor: Pick one square inside or outside the building. Every zombie corpse in that building is gathered onto it.
UI_BOYD_Annoyed: I'm not doing this with the dead walking around!
UI_Farming_Till_Tooltip: Drag an area. Each tillable square is turned into a furrow (shovel if you have one, hands otherwise).
UI_Farming_Remove_Tooltip: Drag an area. Every plant in it is dug out of its furrow.
UI_Farming_Fertilize_Tooltip: Drag an area. Every living plant in it is fertilized.
UI_Farming_Water_Tooltip: Drag an area. Plants are watered to 100% using your carried container, until it runs dry.
UI_Farming_Req_Water: A water container with water in it
UI_Farming_WaterSource_Tooltip: Pick a water source square (well, rain barrel, sink...), then drag an area. Plants are watered to 100%, refilling your container as needed.
UI_Farming_Harvest_Tooltip: Drag an area. Every ready crop is harvested.
UI_Farming_Sow_Tooltip: Drag an area of furrows. Each empty furrow is seeded until you run out. Open seed packets first to sow packeted seeds.
UI_Farming_Treat_Tooltip: Drag an area. Every diseased plant is treated until your spray runs out.
